title: Unit Event — MORE MORE Making Christmas — Episode8 My First Meet & Greet

meta.Event Outline: Following the success of the elementary school event, the girls start planning for another show in real life, but encounter various obstacles along the way. Just when things seem difficult, they receive an email from a fan offering to help. Minori is thrilled, but...

rows.Line: Doors Open
Shibuya Okuyama Building - Hall

rows.Speaker: Guide A
rows.Line:
Thank you for joining us today!
Please move forward in an orderly manner!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's turning out to be a good crowd.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and all of the staff seem so motivated about making sure everything goes well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Got our schedule down, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We'll start with a Christmas talk show that includes some of our own experiences, a meet and greet, and a mini-concert to cap it all off!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds about right. It's good to see that you're not letting your nerves get the better of you. Looks like the Fan Festival's done wonders for you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It certainly has.
Let's all do everything we can to make this event a success!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Merry Christmas, everyone!
We're MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for being here today!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!'s the best!!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: They're so cute!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh wow...!
There are so many people in the audience...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: L-Let's jump right into the first part of our event...! The “MMJ Christmas Talk Show!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Yay!!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Lighting Technician A
rows.Line: Make sure to cut out after the second song! After that, just wait for the signal to turn the stage lights back on!

rows.Speaker: Lighting Technician B
rows.Line: Copy that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Good, that was perfectly timed...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Nice work! I'm glad we practiced that part!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The smiles on our fans' faces are sparkling, and they're cheering their hearts out...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I must be dreaming...!
But this isn't a dream...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (This is all happening because we came together to build this from the ground up...!!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay... Next is the meet and greet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wah...!
So many people...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The fans don't really seem to know where to line up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We only have a few guides and they already have their hands full. If this keeps up, we might need to step in...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Please form a single-file line, everybody!!!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Wah! So loud!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Who was that? Where are they?

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
The end of Minori's line is here!
Please make sure to stay within the hall as much as possible!!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
You all still have plenty of time!
You'll all be able to meet everyone from MORE MORE JUMP! Please proceed in an orderly manner!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Oh, the orange placard!
That must be the line for Minori!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: And the blue one's for Haruka, right?

rows.Speaker: Crowd Controllers
rows.Line: She's not on the crowd control team, but she's helping us anyway? That means I need to keep trying too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Look, all the fans are starting to move...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's amazing! The staff are working really hard to make sure they form neat lines...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You can thank them later, Minori.
We should take this chance to move to the meet-and-greet booths.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Fan
rows.Line: H-Haruka...! It's so great to see you again!! I'm so happy that you decided to become an idol again...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you... Oh, didn't we meet at the dome concert two years ago...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Fan
rows.Line: What?! Y-You remember me?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. You mentioned that you live in Okinawa. I still have that postcard you sent me on display in my living room.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to give you a little Christmas present in return. I hope you like it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka's Fan
rows.Line: Haruka... I'll treasure it forever...!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Fan
rows.Line: I saw the event you guys did at the elementary school, Airi! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You did? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Fan
rows.Line: Always! I just want to say that I've been a huge fan since you were with QT and on all those variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Fan
rows.Line: Getting to see Happy Everyday again made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I appreciate your kind words...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Fan
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
That mask...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's Happy Everyday! Thank you for your support. I hope we get to see more of each other!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank for you coming to see us today.
Have you been enjoying the show?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Fan
rows.Line: Yes! I can't believe I'm shaking hands with you like this... I must be dreaming!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Fan
rows.Line: Um... I always loved seeing the perfect Shizuku Hinomori of Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Fan
rows.Line: But getting to see you in a new light with MORE MORE JUMP! has been so exciting too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Fan
rows.Line: And I definitely like the current you more. We get to see the real you now, so I'm really glad that you joined MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*...!
Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Whoa...! The number of fans lining up for those three is incredible...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: Minori, you have fans waiting!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! S-Sorry!
Wait, fans...?

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line:
Yes, quite a few are waiting in line!
I hope you're ready for them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-My fans...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That's right. I'm an idol who can spread hope to others now...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I still don't really feel like one yet, but does this mean I can be just like my heroes from when I was growing up? A real idol?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, don't say whether or not you can. I will become that idol!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello!
Thank you for joining us today!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Looks like Minori's having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that we were able to put on this event...)

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <This concludes the MORE MORE JUMP! Christmas Fan Event.>

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <Please make sure not to leave anything behind on your way out.>

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
That was really fun!
Seeing MORE MORE JUMP! live was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I know, right? To be fair, I was pretty scared about what would happen after they started recruiting fans to work as staff... But everything went great!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, I really want to see them again!
Maybe I'll join on as staff next time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew... That's it. Our event's over.
Nice work today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Nice work!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for being here today! We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We can't express our gratitude enough.
This event was able to succeed because of you, so again, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we've prepared some presents for each of you as a token of our appreciation. I hope you'll be willing to accept them.

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
Are these handkerchiefs...?
With our initials stitched in?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We had a discussion about how we can make this moment feel special, and we decided to make something for you in our spare time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku really has a talent for embroidery! The rest of us made you some snacks to go with your present!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We all put a lot of effort into making these, so we really hope that you like them!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Yay! This is so awesome!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: There's actually something we'd like to present to you as well, MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Present to us?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes! Ready, everyone? One, two...

rows.Speaker: Saito, Yuina & Staff
rows.Line:
Minori, Haruka, Airi, Shizuku!
Congratulations on a successful first event!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Such a beautiful bouquet...!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Um... I actually applied to work as staff for today because I just wanted a chance to see all of you up close...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't realize that working on something like this would be so hard, and I was worried that we wouldn't get everything set up in time...

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line: But seeing all of you putting so much effort into it gave me the motivation to keep going!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Helping MORE MORE JUMP! spread so much hope to others really turned out to be a great experience! Thank you!!

rows.Speaker: Yuina
rows.Line: You four are our favorite idols and genuinely lifted our spirits today! I'll never forget what happened today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'll never forget...!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It'll be a special experience for them since they'll get to see their favorite idols smile by making their event a success.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But this is what I really think!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fans don't just want to see idols shine and sparkle.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Fans will be there to support their favorite idols through thick and thin! They'll cheer for them no matter what if it means they'll keep shining!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thank you, KAITO. Thank you, Minori...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Without you both, I never would've been able to experience this sensation.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was wonderful putting this event together with all of you. From the bottom of my heart, thank you...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness our event ended up going so well!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? And I love how they surprised us with this giant bouquet at the end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was worried about what would happen at first, but putting on events with our fans like this might be a good way to go for us...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: C-Can I just say something?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'd like to do this again!
I want to put on another event that puts smiles on our fans' faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. I didn't realize that working on something like this would be so hard, and I was worried that we wouldn't get everything set up in time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means we'll have to start expanding our song repertoire.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That'd be great. Why don't we start discussing what we'll be doing the next time we meet?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (A lot's happened along the way, but I've gone from being a Haruka admirer to being an idol just like the others...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (On top of that, we were able to work with our fans to put on an unforgettable event! I couldn't be happier!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I always thought that idols were the only ones who could spread hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I realize now that our fans can also be just as powerful a source of hope.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Which means I'm gonna need to keep trying harder and harder! I need to spread more and more hope to return the favor!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I have to keep growing as an idol for that to happen...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Tomorrow, I'm gonna keep trying more and more!!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: 02_idol_ed1
